subject: Final push: competing offer for Senior LLM Infra - quick decision needed
messages:
From: Sarah Lopez <sarah@compasstalent.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Candidate update - Elena Park (Senior LLM Infra) competing offer (needs decision)

Hi Naomi / Jonas / Marissa,

Quick heads up from the candidate side — Elena Park (finalist for Senior LLM Infrastructure) just received a competing offer from a stealth-funded startup. She prefers Redwood, but they need a firm yes/no by end of day Wednesday PST (Nov 3) so they don't lose leverage.

I attached a one-page summary of the competing offer and their ask: basically ~10% higher base + earlier refresh / faster equity vesting. Candidate is asking if Redwood can move on base or add a one-time signing bonus + a modest RSU uplift. She explicitly said culture and roadmap make Redwood her first choice, she just needs the economics to be competitive.

Elena is willing to sign quickly if we can: 1) confirm target comp band alignment, 2) provide a signed offer (PDF or DocuSign) she can return, and 3) commit to start date window (target Jan 10).

Attaching competing_offer_summary.pdf for context.

Can we do a quick internal decision call / reply thread so we can get something firm to her by EOD Wed? I can coordinate sending the formal offer once you confirm parameters.

Thanks,
Sarah Lopez
Senior Recruiter, Compass Talent
(sarah@compasstalent.io)

Attachment: competing_offer_summary.pdf
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 16:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate update - Elena Park (Senior LLM Infra) competing offer (needs decision)

Jonas / Karthik / Marissa —

Flagging Sarah's note: Elena is high on our list and the hiring manager (Marissa) already gave positive feedback on impact and team fit. We have a firm headcount for the role but I need sign-off on two things before we can send a revised offer:

- Is there flexibility to top-of-band base or do we keep base in-band and use a one-time signing bonus + RSU uplift?
- Legal/Finance: can we expedite DocuSign + start paperwork within 24 hours of approval?

My proposal to close quickly: keep base within band, offer a $25k one-time signing bonus + +10% RSU target uplift (front-loaded over first 18 months). That should be below the cost of moving base and is easier to approve quickly. If that sounds OK I'll ask Sarah to share the exact language and we can route to Legal for DocuSign.

Pls reply with a short yes/no + any constraints.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Talent & Ops, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 17:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate update - Elena Park (Senior LLM Infra) competing offer (needs decision)

+1 on Naomi's proposal.

I think the one-time signing bonus + modest RSU uplift is the right path — keeps us inside comp band guidance and won't create compression for other offers. Finance: please confirm we can fund a $25k signing bonus and front-load an RSU uplift of 10% (accelerated vesting schedule for the first 18 months). Legal: please standby to generate a v3 offer with those terms (I want DocuSign ready so we don't lose the window).

If anyone thinks Elena's competing offer is materially higher in long-term upside (equity structure), call it out now. Otherwise let's commit.

—Jonas
Director, Platform Eng
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate update - Elena Park (Senior LLM Infra) competing offer (needs decision)

Thanks — Finance confirms we can cover a $25k one-time signing bonus. On RSUs: we can grant a 10% uplift to the target (within manager discretion) but legal will need the explicit accelerated schedule for the first 18 months in the offer (typical practice: 33% at 6 months, remainder monthly). That keeps comp cost visible on the books and avoids moving the base band.

Marissa — please confirm you're okay with the accelerated schedule and the Jan 10 start window. If yes, I'll mark budget as committed and loop Legal to produce Redwood_Offer_ElenaPark_v3.pdf for signature.

On a related note, keep in mind team headcount budget is tight for Q1; let's lock this as a priority hire to avoid reallocation issues.

-Karthik
VP, Finance (People Ops partner)
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@gmail.com>
Cc: Sarah Lopez <sarah@compasstalent.io>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Offer update and deadline extension (Senior LLM Infrastructure)

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the candid update and for letting us know the timeline. We had an internal alignment and are prepared to make an updated offer that keeps your base within our comp band and includes the following to bridge to the competing package:

- $25,000 one-time signing bonus (paid on first paycheck)
- 10% uplift to the standard RSU target with accelerated vesting for the first 18 months (33% @ 6 months, then monthly)
- Target start date window: Jan 10 ± 2 weeks

We are ready to send a formal offer document (DocuSign) for signature. Please see the attached Redwood_Offer_ElenaPark_v3.pdf. We can hold the offer open to you until 11:59pm PT on Wed, Nov 3. If you need a slight extension we can consider, but we wanted to give a firm window to respect their competing process.

If this works, sign the attached and return the signed PDF or accept via DocuSign and we'll start onboarding paperwork. Sarah will coordinate logistics.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Talent & Ops, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_Offer_ElenaPark_v3.pdf
From: Elena Park <elena.park@gmail.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lopez <sarah@compasstalent.io>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Offer update and deadline extension (Senior LLM Infrastructure)

Naomi / Sarah —

Thank you so much — I appreciate the quick work here. The revised package looks great and I am excited about Redwood's team and roadmap. I attached the signed offer (Redwood_Signed_Offer_ElenaPark.pdf). I will formally withdraw my other offer this morning.

Looking forward to next steps on onboarding and my manager intro with Marissa.

Best,
Elena Park
elena.park@gmail.com

Attachment: Redwood_Signed_Offer_ElenaPark.pdf
